verdict.rationale: Requesty supports service accounts (non-human entities) and per-key/service-account spend caps, and BYOK lets teams route through Requesty without exposing raw provider keys downstream to apps. However, there is no explicit documentation of a self-service key-minting workflow, key scoping/permissions per team, or key rotation/revocation processes. missing for 10: explicit key-minting/issuance API or UI flow, team-level RBAC on keys, key rotation/revocation documentation, and independent confirmation that raw provider keys are never exposed to end apps.
